ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is quadrilateral ABCD, vertex B is at the upper left, C is at the upper right, D is at the lower right, A is at the lower left; sides AB, BC, CD, DA form a rhombus, and the diagonal AC from A to C is drawn. The required ∠DAC is at point A, the angle formed by AD and AC. Reasoning: The problem gives that ABCD is a rhombus, and m∠BCD=120°. A rhombus is a parallelogram, so opposite angles are equal, therefore ∠DAB=∠BCD=120°. The diagonals of a rhombus bisect the interior angles at their endpoints, so diagonal AC bisects ∠DAB. Thus m∠DAC=120°÷2=60°.

raw_record.question_text: Quadrilateral ABCD is a rhombus. If $m\angle BCD = 120$, find $m\angle DAC$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as rhombus ABCD with vertices labeled B top-left, C top-right, D bottom-right, A bottom-left, and diagonal AC drawn; the desired angle DAC is the angle at A between DA and CA. From the text, use that ABCD is a rhombus and that angle BCD is 120°. Since a rhombus is a parallelogram, opposite angles are equal, so angle DAB is also 120°. In a rhombus, each diagonal bisects the angles at its endpoints, so diagonal AC bisects angle DAB. Therefore angle DAC = 120°/2 = 60°.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a rhombus with side CD adjacent to side DA through vertex D, and diagonal AC forming triangle ACD. From the text, angle BCD is 120°. In a rhombus/parallelogram, consecutive interior angles are supplementary, so angle CDA = 180° - 120° = 60°. Also, because ABCD is a rhombus, AD = CD. Thus triangle ACD is isosceles with equal sides AD and CD and included angle ∠CDA = 60°. The remaining two angles are equal and sum to 120°, so each is 60°. Hence m∠DAC = 60°.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中四边形 ABCD 的顶点大致为 B 在左上、C 在右上、D 在右下、A 在左下，并画出了从 A 到 C 的对角线 AC，因此可以看到由 AD、CD 和 AC 组成的三角形 ACD。再推理：题目给出 ABCD 是菱形，且 m∠BCD = 120°。菱形也是平行四边形，所以相邻内角互补，∠BCD 与 ∠CDA 相邻，因此 m∠CDA = 180° - 120° = 60°。又因为 ABCD 是菱形，所以 AD = CD。于是三角形 ACD 是等腰三角形，且顶角 ∠CDA = 60°，另外两个底角相等并且和为 120°，所以每个底角都是 60°。因此 m∠DAC = 60°。
